name: Shanghai Operations / 上海多制式运营
author: LeoVan1412
description:
Shanghai Operations / 上海多制式运营 adds a route-first planning and reversible native-service workflow for the Shanghai PVG map. **Development preview 0.8.1-dev.2 — not production-ready.**

**What players can do**

Choose local, fast or express stopping patterns and combine compatible through-services.

Inspect real-track map previews, infrastructure-aware station recommendations and fleet guidance before applying a separate native service.

Use five PVG track/vehicle tiers: 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 300 km/h. Fleet guidance considers native round-trip time, shortest platform, inventory and allocation to other services; planned fleet is shown separately from actual deployment.

Undo tool-owned changes using persisted ownership records; later manual edits can restrict undo. Keeping existing route objects does not guarantee zero delay on shared infrastructure.

**Specific distinction from the existing Shanghai map and other mods**

This is an independent operations-code mod, **not a new geographic map**, a renamed map submission, or a claim of higher census/commute data quality. It adds the integrated route → stops → station roles → fleet → native service → scoped undo workflow on top of the separate PVG map. No geographic map data or prebuilt network save is bundled.

The earlier PVG map submission [PR #9355](https://github.com/Subway-Builder-Modded/registry/pull/9355) was declined for not improving data quality over the existing Shanghai map. We disclose that decision and are asking for review in the gameplay-mod category, not reopening or bypassing the map-quality decision. **PVG is not currently in the community catalog, and compatibility with the existing SHA Shanghai map is not implemented. Please confirm whether a PVG-only companion mod is acceptable before considering merge.**

Other train, speed-tier, mode-management, track-import and restriction-adjustment mods overlap with individual features. Our proposed distinction is workflow integration and reversible application, not exclusive ownership of these ideas. The [comparison](https://github.com/LeoVan1412/shanghai-operations/blob/main/docs/COMPARISON.md) includes a dated comparison record; it is not an audit of every current competitor version.

**Development-only features and remaining acceptance**

Advanced 2/4/6/8-track construction, automatic bypass and dynamic passing interfaces exist, but the ordinary-player activation workflow is incomplete. Installation does not automatically enable advanced dispatch.

Missing passing infrastructure is identified as requiring modification; station advice is not a promise that any hub can already be rebuilt from the normal UI.

Full-passenger-cycle/long-duration testing, comprehensive throat/layout coverage and large-network frame-time testing remain incomplete. **publishReady=false. Please review as a development preview, not as a stable release.**

Manifest compatibility is >=1.7.0; loaded-game evidence is limited to Subway Builder 1.7.2 and does not certify all later versions. Testing requires independent backups.

**Inspectable evidence**

The unchanged runtime had a targeted 1.7.2 test with 43 original routes / 228 original trains, 8 new native trains and 7,368 simulated seconds. Three of five holds independently verified actual passing; the other two are not counted. The two original T1 trains had no timeout removal in that run. This is limited evidence, not full operating certification. Seven offline regression suites and isolated reproducible packaging passed; splitting the repository added no new loaded-game evidence.

中文：本申请是独立玩法模组，不以运营功能提高地图数据评分。主流程为线路选择、快慢停站与兼容直通、站型与配车预览、原生服务落地和按归属撤销。当前仅支持 PVG，不支持社区 SHA；高级自动接轨和动态越行的玩家启用流程、长周期及多站型验收尚未完成。请维护者先确认这一依赖和开发预览形式是否可接收。
